newsitem.title: USA: Renaissance Hotel reviewing merger deal.
newsitem.headline: Renaissance Hotel reviewing merger deal.

text.p: Renaissance Hotel Group NV Thursday said its board of managing directors is reviewing proposed merger terms with Doubletree Corp and negotiations between the parties on a memorandum of understanding are in progress.

In a statement, the company said no agreement with respect to the proposed transaction has yet been reached, nor have the terms of any transaction been approved by the board. No assurances can be given as to the completion, timing or final terms and conditions of a transaction, the company added.
On Tuesday, Doubletree said it agreed to buy Renaissance Hotel Group in a stock and cash transaction valued at $850 million, including the assumption of $70 million of debt.
The companies said they expected to execute a memorandum of understanding within two days.
A spokeswoman for Doubletree said both sides are still working toward achieving a memorandum of understanding but she could not say when that might happen.
